tasks.label: docker: build builder image (arm64)
tasks.command: sg docker -c 'docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 -t openautoflutter-builder-arm64 --load .'

tasks.label: docker: flutter build linux (example)
tasks.command: sg docker -c 'docker run --rm -t -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace/example openautoflutter-builder flutter build linux -v'

tasks.label: docker: flutter clean (example)
tasks.command: sg docker -c 'docker run --rm -t -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace/example openautoflutter-builder flutter clean'

tasks.label: docker: flutter build linux arm64 (example)
tasks.command: rm -f example/linux/flutter/ephemeral/.plugin_symlinks/openautoflutter && sg docker -c 'docker run --rm -t --platform linux/arm64 -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace/example openautoflutter-builder-arm64 bash -c "flutter pub get && flutter build linux"' && ln -snf ${workspaceFolder} example/linux/flutter/ephemeral/.plugin_symlinks/openautoflutter

tasks.label: debuglantern: build debug bundle (arm64)
tasks.command: sg docker -c 'docker run --rm -t --platform linux/arm64 -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace openautoflutter-builder-arm64 bash scripts/build_flutter_drm_release_arm64.sh example' && ln -snf ${workspaceFolder} example/linux/flutter/ephemeral/.plugin_symlinks/openautoflutter
